subject: zoology_2
question_text: What are the measures one has to take to prevent contracting STDs?

verification.note: Sourced from 'My Baby Bullet-Q — Senior Inter Zoology' (Star-Q Pass Track Series, Sri Publishers, 2022), book p.56, VSAQ 112. The printed exam years are the book's claim, reproduced here as appearances. Zoology-II holds only ONE source book in the corpus, so the two-book union check is structurally impossible for this card; 'not checked' does NOT mean 'checked and clean'. The mark split is our reading of the question and is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Avoiding infection
steps.why: These diseases spread by contact, so the first defence is to prevent the contact itself.
common_mistakes: Giving only one measure when several are asked.
Naming a vaccine. Most STDs have none.
steps.memory_tip: Avoid the contact first, then protect the contact.
steps.margin_note: Number the measures. The examiner ticks each one.

steps.label: Detection and treatment
steps.why: Many of these infections are silent early on, so only a check-up finds them while they can still be cured.
common_mistakes: Stopping at prevention. Early detection is also asked.
Writing that treatment can be stopped once the symptoms go.
steps.margin_note: Two more numbered measures finish the answer.

lines.text: 4. Take the complete treatment if infected

insider_note: Four measures, two marks. Give at least three — a single line about condoms is marked as half an answer.
